name: Kimi Code
notes: Membership subscription with no per-token prices; each model carries the list prices of its Moonshot pay-as-you-go API equivalent (from models.dev), so Cost is what a request would cost there. The docs give overseas (api.kimi.ai) and China (api.kimi.com) hosts, and an Anthropic-compatible endpoint at https://api.kimi.ai/coding/. The auth header is not stated; bearer is what the OpenAI-compatible endpoint implies. Tools and structured output are not stated per model, so they come from models.dev. The docs require third-party tools to send their real User-Agent. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/).

upstreamModels.notes: 1M context on the Pro plan and above. Thinking required. Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k3.1-pro. maxOutputTokens is the Moonshot API value for kimi-k3.1-pro. tools and structured-output come from models.dev.
Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed. maxOutputTokens is the Moonshot API value for kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed. tools and structured-output come from models.dev.
Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k3. maxOutputTokens is the Moonshot API value for kimi-k3. tools and structured-output come from models.dev.
Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k3. maxOutputTokens is the Moonshot API value for kimi-k3. tools and structured-output come from models.dev.

Docs call it K2.8 Preview. Moonshot does not sell K2.8 Preview through its own API; prices are the rate third-party gateways list on models.dev, and cache write is set to the input price. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev. tools comes from models.dev.

Docs call it K2.7 Code HighSpeed. Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed; cache write is not published and is set to the input price, since caching is automatic. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev. tools and structured-output come from models.dev.
